metadata.algorithm: TF-IDF (word unigrams/bigrams, sublinear TF, L2 normalization) + multinomial logistic regression (SGD)
metadata.engine: Python standard library; portable JSON weights
metadata.selection: validation log loss; test never used for fitting or epoch selection
